The functions `prepare()`, `build()`, and `package()` are defined but will not be executed during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`, as this command only sources the global scope. Therefore, any potentially risky operations inside those functions (such as `cargo fetch` or `cargo build`) are not relevant to this safety gate. The environment variables set within those functions do not affect the global scope and are not leaked.

No suspicious network operations, file operations, or data exfiltration attempts occur at parse time. The file adheres to standard AUR packaging practices and poses no risk during the metadata parsing phase.
</details>
